chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 319: The Grand Assembly Begins – A Sea of 100,000 Geniuses!
chapter_meta_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly officially begins! Over 100,000 geniuses gather in the Grand Xia capital. Ji Ning reunites with old friends and witnesses the terrifying scale of the Empire’s ultimate trials.
og_title: The Grand Assembly Begins – A Million Cultivators Gather!
og_description: Ji Ning enters the imperial palace for the deadly Immortal Fortunes Assembly. Will a hundred thousand Wanxiang Adepts survive the night? The stage is set for an epic Xianxia battle royale.
twitter_title: The Grand Assembly Begins – A Hundred Thousand Geniuses!
twitter_description: Ji Ning enters the Grand Xia capital for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly. Old flames and new threats await in the ultimate tournament arc!

lore_anchors.definition: Ancient Immortal-ranked chimes that resonate with the heavenly laws of the Grand Xia Dynasty. Their nine tolls signal the opening of the imperial palace for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.

An immense, continent-spanning defensive formation powered by multiple Pure Yang treasures and thousands of Immortal-ranked artifacts. It is the ultimate bulwark of a major world, usually set up by an unfathomably powerful Celestial Immortal or True God.
The Grand Xia Dynasty’s grand tournament, held every few millennia, where the empire’s most talented Wanxiang Adepts compete for a chance to be apprenticed to its most powerful Celestial Immortals.
The celestial palace of the Grand Xia Emperor, surrounded by clouds and situated at the highest point of the imperial capital.
A powerful Celestial Immortal and feudal prince of the Grand Xia Dynasty. He is the guardian of Ji Ning’s cousin, Yuchi Xiyue.
The awakened artifact spirit of the Starseizing Manor. It possesses immense knowledge of the Three Realms and has a deep, reverential respect for its master, Daoist Threelives.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the ordinary spectators enter the palace?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Imperial Palace is a heavily fortified zone covered by the world-protecting formation. Only participants, vassals with official tokens, and Celestial Immortals (who can each bring one or two attendants) are allowed inside. The masses watch from outside.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the 'cousin-brother' relationship?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Chinese culture, a 'cousin-brother/sister' on the maternal side (表亲) is considered a closer bond than a paternal cousin. Yuchi Xiyue is Ji Ning's maternal cousin, meaning their mothers are sisters, making her his closest living blood relative outside of his parents.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Yellow-Maned Bear so shocked by the formation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The artifact spirit is used to the top-tier power of its master, but it recognizes that the Grand Xia's world-protecting formation was designed by a being with nearly equal status to Daoist Threelives. This implies the Emperor is backed by a truly ancient, top-level power in the Three Realms.
